world.title: Orphan Chinese man invites strangers to his wedding after fearing few people would attend; more than 10,000 turn up with gifts, food and a Maybach; videos go viral
world.summary: A young orphaned man in China feared his wedding would lack attendees due to having few relatives. He posted an open invitation on Douyin, leading to over 10,000 strangers attending his celebration. Guests brought gifts, food, and even a Maybach. The event garnered significant attention online, with videos of the wedding going viral across social media platforms.

world.title: 'This Project Should Unite All Americans': Trump Closes Midterm Speech Pitching Reflecting Pool Makeover
world.summary: During his final campaign address, President Donald Trump highlighted the renovation of the Reflecting Pool, which is estimated to cost around $15 million. He emphasized the project as a means to unite all Americans, despite existing controversies surrounding the renovation. The Reflecting Pool's reopening served as a significant focal point in his midterm election pitch.

world.title: Trump approval rating near record low on eve of US midterm elections: Poll
world.summary: Ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, President Donald Trump's job approval rating is at 32 percent, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll. This figure reflects a continued decline in support, nearing a record low. The poll indicates that only a small fraction of voters are satisfied with Trump's performance as president, raising concerns for his party's prospects in the elections.

business.title: Patanjali ghee among food stock worth Rs 9 crore seized in Maharashtra FDA crackdown
business.summary: The Maharashtra FDA suspended 19 food business licences and seized food items valued at Rs 9.01 crore during a festive-season enforcement drive. The operation revealed suspected adulteration, hygiene issues, and food safety violations across seven divisions. Among the seized items was ghee from Patanjali Ayurved, highlighting concerns regarding food quality and compliance with safety regulations.

business.title: A month after RBI’s rate hike, banks start raising deposit rates as liquidity shrinks, Bank of India the latest to move
business.summary: Domestic banks are raising deposit rates as liquidity conditions tighten. The Bank of India has announced increased rates for various maturities, including a special 500-day option. This move reflects the rising cost of deposits amid increasing credit demand. Overall banking system liquidity has significantly decreased since its peak in early September, prompting banks to adjust their deposit offerings.

technology.title: Microsoft AI chief warns against conscious AI and model welfare
technology.summary: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman has urged a halt to AI development if consciousness emerges during training, emphasizing the need to address model welfare. His comments follow discussions on AI rights, safety, and human oversight. Suleyman critiques Anthropic’s approach to its AI model, Claude, highlighting the importance of ensuring ethical considerations in AI advancements and their potential implications.

technology.title: 'Nobody wants to wear a tuna can on their wrist' Garmin's COO explains how the Fenix 9 Pro and Marq Gen 3's new nano-molded titanium case stayed as small as possible while still letting signals in and
technology.summary: Garmin's COO discussed the development of the Fenix 9 Pro and Marq Gen 3, highlighting the use of nano-molded titanium for their cases. This material is favored for fitness watches due to its strength and lightweight properties. The design aims to keep the watches compact while ensuring signal reception, addressing consumer preferences for functionality without excessive bulk.

technology.title: All Fortnite Treasure Hunt Chest Locations and Free Rewards
technology.summary: Fortnite's new Treasure Hunters mini-season introduces Treasure Hunt Chests, enhancing gameplay with a pirate theme inspired by One Piece. Players can discover these chests throughout the game, offering various free rewards. A guide is available to help players locate all Treasure Hunt Chest locations and maximize their in-game benefits during this limited-time event.

sports.title: Tactical Analysis: Real Madrid’s First-Half Domination Ends Racing Santander’s Home Unbeaten Run
sports.summary: Real Madrid defeated Racing Santander, ending the latter's unbeaten home record. The team, under Mourinho, showcased effective progressive build-up and wide play, contributing to their sixth consecutive victory. Most players from the recent El Clásico retained their positions, reflecting Mourinho's tactical consistency. The strategies implemented since the Leipzig match continue to evolve, enhancing the team's overall performance.

sports.title: Australia’s Glenn Maxwell calls time on international career
sports.summary: Glenn Maxwell has announced his retirement from international cricket, concluding a notable T20ODI career. The 38-year-old batsman, who last played a Test in 2017, made the announcement on November 3, 2026, after being excluded from Australia’s upcoming Twenty20 series against England. Maxwell's decision marks the end of an impactful chapter in Australian cricket.

sports.title: BK vs JKB Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Biratnagar Kings (BK) will face Janakpur Bolts (JKB) in match 12 of the Nepal Premier League 2026 on November 3, 2026, at 12:15 IST. The match will take place at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground. Predictions and betting tips for the game are available, along with live score updates, as teams prepare for this T20 encounter.

health.title: How your body clock affects your mental health and ways to keep it in sync
health.summary: Disrupted body clocks can negatively impact mental health, influencing mood and emotions. Research highlights the importance of circadian rhythms, which regulate alertness, hormones, and body temperature. Factors such as sleep quality, light exposure, and meal timing play significant roles in maintaining these rhythms. Understanding and synchronizing these elements can help improve mental well-being and emotional stability.

health.title: Omega-3 supplements boost brain health: Myth or fact?
health.summary: Omega-3 supplements are frequently promoted for improving memory and protecting against Alzheimer's disease. However, recent clinical trials have raised questions about the validity of these claims. Researchers are investigating whether there is substantial scientific evidence supporting the benefits of Omega-3s for brain health or if these assertions are merely health myths lacking concrete backing from rigorous studies.

health.title: US FDA grants tentative nod to Dr Reddy's twice-yearly HIV prevention drug
health.summary: The US FDA has granted tentative approval to Dr Reddy's Laboratories for its generic lenacapavir, a twice-yearly HIV prevention injection. This approval aims to enhance affordable access to the drug in 120 countries outside the United States. The initiative is expected to significantly improve HIV prevention efforts globally, making the treatment more accessible to those in need.

science.title: Redefining the edge of the solar system
science.source: Room The Space Journal of Asgardia
science.summary: The Milky Way’s gravitational field, including dark matter, may redefine the solar system's boundaries. Historically, Pluto was considered the edge, but recent studies suggest that the sun's sphere of influence extends further. This challenges traditional definitions of space boundaries, emphasizing the complexity of astronomical scales and the need for updated understandings of the solar system's limits.

science.title: An Ancient Indigenous Practice Could Help Marine Life Survive a More Acidic Ocean
science.summary: Indigenous communities on North America's Pacific coast have practiced marine stewardship for thousands of years by crushing old seashells and mixing them into sand where new clams grow. This ancient method may help marine life adapt to increasingly acidic ocean conditions. The practice is based on traditional ecological knowledge and aims to enhance the resilience of marine ecosystems.

science.title: Where Pieces of NASA's Swift Observatory May Crash This Week
science.summary: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory is expected to reenter Earth’s atmosphere this week after a failed rescue mission. While most of the spacecraft will likely disintegrate upon reentry, experts estimate that approximately 100 kilograms of debris may survive the descent. The exact landing location remains uncertain, but potential crash sites include oceans and uninhabited areas.
